\section[(dialogue)]{Places, can and want — a first pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R110-first-pass-places-can-and-want}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a phone and glasses.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a crossroads, around, with, a market, a police station
  \item a palace, a park, a cinema, a field, a door
  \item a kitchen, a bathroom, a ticket, an office, a library
  \item an aeroplane, a train, near; with, to be able to, to manage to
  \item a skill, able, is needed, a wish, a need
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A crossroads? (\textbf{\ur{چوراہا}}, \emph{chaurāhā}.) Around? (\textbf{\ur{آس} \ur{پاس}}, \emph{ās pās}.) With? (\textbf{\ur{ساتھ}}, \emph{sāth}.) A market? (\textbf{\ur{بازار}}, \emph{bāzār}.) A police station? (\textbf{\ur{تھانہ}}, \emph{thānā}.) A palace? (\textbf{\ur{محل}}, \emph{mahal}.) A park? (\textbf{\ur{پارک}}, \emph{pārk}.) A cinema? (\textbf{\ur{سینما}}, \emph{sinemā}.) A field? (\textbf{\ur{میدان}}, \emph{maidān}.) A door? (\textbf{\ur{دروازہ}}, \emph{darvāzā}.) A kitchen? (\textbf{\ur{باورچی} \ur{خانہ}}, \emph{bāvarchīkhānā}.) A bathroom? (\textbf{\ur{باتھ} \ur{روم}}, \emph{bāthrūm}.) A ticket? (\textbf{\ur{ٹکٹ}}, \emph{ṭikaṭ}.) An office? (\textbf{\ur{دفتر}}, \emph{daftar}.) A library? (\textbf{\ur{کتب} \ur{خانہ}}, \emph{kutubkhānā}.) An aeroplane? (\textbf{\ur{ہوائی} \ur{جہاز}}, \emph{hawāī jahāz}.) A train? (\textbf{\ur{ریل} \ur{گاڑی}}, \emph{rel gāṛī}.) Near; with? (\textbf{\ur{پاس}}, \emph{pās}.) To be able to? (\textbf{\ur{سکنا}}, \emph{saknā}.) To manage to? (\textbf{\ur{پانا}}, \emph{pānā}.) A skill? (\textbf{\ur{ہنر}}, \emph{hunar}.) Able? (\textbf{\ur{قابل}}, \emph{qābil}.) Is needed? (\textbf{\ur{چاہیے}}, \emph{chāhiye}.) A wish? (\textbf{\ur{خواہش}}, \emph{khvāhish}.) A need? (\textbf{\ur{ضرورت}}, \emph{zarūrat}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Things in the house — a second pass}

\label{lesson:UR-R110-second-pass-things-in-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a keen interest and an intention.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a keen interest, an intention, a table, scissors, a needle
  \item thread, a towel, a comb, glass, a pillow
  \item a blanket, a curtain, a sheet, a bucket, a rope
  \item a nail, a hammer, a lock, a fan, electricity; lightning
  \item a stove, a pot, a plate, a drinking glass, a fridge
  \item a television, a computer, a mobile phone, a phone, glasses
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A keen interest? (\textbf{\ur{شوق}}, \emph{shauq}.) An intention? (\textbf{\ur{ارادہ}}, \emph{irādā}.) A table? (\textbf{\ur{میز}}, \emph{mez}.) Scissors? (\textbf{\ur{قینچی}}, \emph{qainchī}.) A needle? (\textbf{\ur{سوئی}}, \emph{sūī}.) Thread? (\textbf{\ur{دھاگا}}, \emph{dhāgā}.) A towel? (\textbf{\ur{تولیہ}}, \emph{tauliyā}.) A comb? (\textbf{\ur{کنگھی}}, \emph{kaṅghī}.) Glass? (\textbf{\ur{شیشہ}}, \emph{shīshā}.) A pillow? (\textbf{\ur{تکیہ}}, \emph{takiyā}.) A blanket? (\textbf{\ur{کمبل}}, \emph{kambal}.) A curtain? (\textbf{\ur{پردہ}}, \emph{pardā}.) A sheet? (\textbf{\ur{چادر}}, \emph{chādar}.) A bucket? (\textbf{\ur{بالٹی}}, \emph{baltī}.) A rope? (\textbf{\ur{رسی}}, \emph{rassī}.) A nail? (\textbf{\ur{کیل}}, \emph{kīl}.) A hammer? (\textbf{\ur{ہتھوڑا}}, \emph{hathauṛā}.) A lock? (\textbf{\ur{تالا}}, \emph{tālā}.) A fan? (\textbf{\ur{پنکھا}}, \emph{pankhā}.) Electricity; lightning? (\textbf{\ur{بجلی}}, \emph{bijlī}.) A stove? (\textbf{\ur{چولہا}}, \emph{chūlhā}.) A pot? (\textbf{\ur{برتن}}, \emph{bartan}.) A plate? (\textbf{\ur{تھالی}}, \emph{thālī}.) A drinking glass? (\textbf{\ur{گلاس}}, \emph{glās}.) A fridge? (\textbf{\ur{فریج}}, \emph{friij}.) A television? (\textbf{\ur{ٹی} \ur{وی}}, \emph{ṭīvī}.) A computer? (\textbf{\ur{کمپیوٹر}}, \emph{kampyūṭar}.) A mobile phone? (\textbf{\ur{موبائل}}, \emph{mobāil}.) A phone? (\textbf{\ur{فون}}, \emph{fon}.) Glasses? (\textbf{\ur{چشمہ}}, \emph{chashmā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
